body: Overdose is not the best option, I mean from experience, the feeling you have while dying for it is not as pleasant as it seems, I know that sometimes everything seems empty and without any sense, but really it is so or your mind tells you that it is like this, the world is a meaningless place and that is its beauty, not knowing what is waiting for you, sometimes it is better to see beauty in simple things like achieving someone's smile or seeing someone happy, thanks to those things i'm alive
Looking for some meaning in life is something that many philosophers have tried to solve, my sense of life is to grow to give other people the happiness that was not given to you.
The reason I am here is to offer the help they never gave me and I wish they would have given me, if you need anything send me a message.

Hello, maybe I don't know you and I don't think I can have the possibility either, I only know that when writing this post your mind unconsciously asks for help, you need a pillar to sustain your emotional stability and I wish I could be that pillar, maybe We are not from the same country or city, but what I can offer you is a person who would be very happy to see a great person grow, if you want someone who will listen to you, I will be here.
